yk-rest-yorker.label: IPL runs per yorker in the death, 2022–2026
yk-rest-yorker.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
yk-rest-yorker.query: SELECT CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (6) THEN 'team' ELSE 'rest' END side, CASE WHEN c.length = 'Yorker' THEN 'Yorker' WHEN c.variation IN ('Slower ball','Off-cutter','Leg-cutter') THEN 'Slower ball / cutter' WHEN c.length IS NOT NULL THEN 'Other labelled ball' END dkind, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.kind NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wk FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN delivery_commentary c ON c.delivery_id = d.delivery_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2022 GROUP BY side, dkind HAVING dkind IS NOT NULL
